title: The PR ledger tests a held review record before a stale one, so a held record on an old head no longer shows "fix check"
why: Coordinator, 07:41 CST Nov 18: in merge/merge.py review_state returns stale (about line 5203) before held (about line 5205), so a held record on an old head can read as a fix check. Decision pr-ledger says a held record matches no record rule and falls to the label, blocked and draft rules (docs/decisions/pr-ledger.md lines 61 to 73), and its part 3b says it fixes this order (line 97). Part 1 (PR 2845, merged 07:24 CST Nov 18) left it.
source: coordinator 07:41 CST Nov 18, relayed to triage 11
note: Not built. Kept out of step status-tab-lists-coord-prs on purpose, because it changes a merge verdict. Lines are the coordinator's reading at 07:41 CST; triage 11 has not read merge/merge.py. Next: a lane brief with a test-author first (a held record on an old head must read as a label, blocked or draft act, not a fix check); mover: whoever takes the lane after the coordinator's say-so.
